review.notes: All 42 bilingual entries read in full. Icicles corrected to explicit ice stalactites and reread. Male/female arrival texts and all four husband/wife combinations retain the mayor’s hesitations and roles; couple names remain standalone to avoid assigning spouse gender. All three player-name occurrences and season/date substitutions retained. Music titles directly translated from English, with Jam rendered as musical wordplay and both Solo/Duet distinguished. Canonical Pelican Town and festival names applied.
